rules.title: Your passport goes to the visa centre
rules.text: Regular visas are stuck into your passport, so you’ll need to submit it at the Indian visa application centre. Don’t book travel you can’t change until it’s back.

rules.title: Allow more time
rules.text: Regular visas take longer than e-Visas, and much longer for people of Pakistani origin. Apply as early as you can.

rules.title: The form must be exact
rules.text: Any mismatch between your form, passport and documents can delay or refuse the application. We check everything line by line.

rules.title: Arrive anywhere
rules.text: Unlike e-Visas, regular visas can be used at any immigration checkpoint in India.

boxTitle: Can you use the e-Business visa instead?
boxText: For most short business trips it’s quicker and fully online.

sections.heading: Indian business visa or e-Business visa?
sections.text: The [e-Business visa](/india-e-business-visa-for-uk-citizens/) covers most short trips for a year. The regular business visa is for people who can’t use the e-Visa, or who need a longer or different arrangement. If you’ll be employed by an Indian company, you need an [Employment visa](/indian-work-visa/).

sections.heading: What letters does an Indian business visa need?
sections.text: Usually an invitation from the Indian company on its letterhead, explaining who you are meeting and why, and a letter from your UK employer confirming your job and the purpose of the trip. We’ll check both letters match your Indian business visa application exactly.

faqs.a: Usually an invitation from the Indian company and a letter from your UK employer. We’ll tell you exactly what yours should say.

faqs.q: Can I apply myself instead of using you?
faqs.a: Yes. You can apply on the official website, indianvisaonline.gov.in, and pay only the government fee. People use us when they want a person to check their eligibility, fix their photo and documents, and handle the form for them so nothing goes wrong.

faqs.q: How long does an Indian business visa take?
faqs.a: Regular visas take longer than e-Visas. Allow a few weeks, and longer for people of Pakistani origin.

faqs.q: Can I make several trips on an Indian business visa?
faqs.a: Regular business visas can allow multiple entries. The length and entries depend on your nationality and case.
